title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.25.1678
body_markdown:
* Improved error handling
* Clean up of Copilot Preferences page
* Added helpful tooltips for first-time users
* Removed editor intention, still available as "Open GitHub Copilot" action
* Improved plugin stability
* Added experimental support for basic proxy configurations (see Copilot Preference page)
